To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the proposed framework for anomaly detection outperforms state of the art methods; 2) the proposed framework can handle temporal, spatial, and event based abnormality detection; 3) the proposed framework is able to deal with the problem of occlusion; 4) a new dataset of 100 crowded scenes is proposed, which includes 5 well defined abnormality detection categories.
